001package com.streamConverter.factory;
002
003/**
004 * Exception thrown when factory operations fail.
005 *
006 * <p>This exception provides specific error handling for factory-related failures, including
007 * instance creation errors, configuration issues, and reflection problems.
008 *
009 * @since 1.0
010 */
011public class FactoryException extends Exception {
012
013  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
014
015  /**
016   * Constructs a FactoryException with the specified detail message.
017   *
018   * @param message the detail message
019   */
020  public FactoryException(String message) {
021    super(message);
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * Constructs a FactoryException with the specified detail message and cause.
026   *
027   * @param message the detail message
028   * @param cause the cause of the exception
029   */
030  public FactoryException(String message, Throwable cause) {
031    super(message, cause);
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Constructs a FactoryException with the specified cause.
036   *
037   * @param cause the cause of the exception
038   */
039  public FactoryException(Throwable cause) {
040    super(cause);
041  }
042}
